adults.description: Number of adult guests across all rooms.

bathrooms.description: Minimum number of bathrooms in the property.

bedPreference__.description: Filter by bed configuration. Multiple values are combined with OR.

bedrooms.description: Minimum number of bedrooms in the property.

checkInDate.description: Check-in date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. Must be in the future and earlier than `checkOutDate`.

checkOutDate.description: Check-out date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. Must be later than `checkInDate`.

children.description: Number of child guests across all rooms (0–10). Pass `0` if there are no children.

childrenAges.description:
Comma-separated list of child ages, one entry per child (each `0`–`17`). Required when `children > 0` and the number of ages must equal `children`.

Example: `1,3,7`

currency.description: Currency of the prices returned in the response. Use `hotelCurrency` to keep each property's native currency. Provide one exact documented value (52 allowed), e.g. `hotelCurrency`, `usd`.

distanceFromCenter__.description: Filter by distance from the destination center. Multiple values are combined with OR.

facilities__.description: Filter by property-level facilities. Multiple values are combined with OR.

keyword.description: Free-text destination query. Usually a city, region or neighborhood (e.g. `Paris`, `Manhattan, New York`); a specific property name is also accepted.

language.description: Language of the Booking.com interface and localized fields in the response.

meals__.description: Filter by available meal plans. Multiple values are combined with OR.

page.description: Page number of the search results. Booking.com returns 25 results per page; pass `2` for results 26–50, `3` for 51–75, etc.

price_max_.description: Maximum total price for the stay, in the requested `currency`. Must be `>= 20` and greater than `price[min]`. Required if `price[min]` is omitted.

price_min_.description: Minimum total price for the stay, in the requested `currency`. Must be `>= 10`. Required if `price[max]` is omitted.

propertyAccessibility__.description: Filter by property-level accessibility features. Multiple values are combined with OR.

propertyType__.description: Filter by property type. Multiple values are combined with OR.

rating__.description: Filter by official star rating. Multiple values are combined with OR.

reservationPolicy__.description: Filter by reservation flexibility. Multiple values are combined with OR.

reviewScore__.description: Filter by minimum guest review score bucket. Multiple values are combined with OR.

roomAccessibility__.description: Filter by in-room accessibility features. Multiple values are combined with OR.

roomFacilities__.description: Filter by in-room facilities. Multiple values are combined with OR.

sort.description: Sort order applied by Booking.com to the results page.

travelGroup__.description: Filter by travel-group oriented stay options. Multiple values are combined with OR.
